# packages/livekit/tests

Plugin tests. Wire vocabulary must match `shared/wire.py`. The realtime
session test speaks the gateway protocol through a fake WebSocket.

## Files

- `test_realtime_model.py`: handshake, identity, transcript, speaker
  change, and 20 ms downlink frames against a fake gateway.
- `test_wire_vocabulary.py`: vendored `wire.py` is byte-identical to
  `shared/wire.py`.
